description: Mechanics-15, 3D: the same 15 mazes, models and settings as run_config.mechanics_15_2d.json (the R1 fixed cell (minimal/egocentric/zero_shot/stateless, step_by_step, progress_stall_k=30) with context_window=full instead of text_summary_and_last_n and prompt caching on, image_only), rendered in MuJoCo: first_person frames plus start_map (one top-down map of the whole maze with the first query). Resolution 'grid' (32 px per cell of the longer side): 576x576 for these 18x18 mazes, the 2D frame size.
_note_no_conditions: No conditions key => single (default) cell built from experiment_config overlay. Do NOT add conditions (that would re-enable the sweep).
_note_requires: context_window=full comes from PR #54 (R2 full context). Launching before it is on the launched SHA fails at config load.
_note_model_params: Equal 64k output caps (max_tokens; max_completion_tokens for OpenAI and Kimi K3). Thinking on for all three. Opus 5.5: effort=xhigh, no sampling params, Message Batches API via the lockstep worker (worker_role=lockstep-worker; coordinator STALE_AFTER_SECONDS >= 12600). Kimi K3: always thinks, reasoning_effort=max (Moonshot's default, set explicitly for provenance), no thinking object or sampling params; plain worker on the sync API (Moonshot Batch support for kimi-k3 unverified). GPT-6 Astra: reasoning_effort=xhigh, flex tier, image_detail=high, plain worker (the OpenAI agent has no batch path), spend_cap_usd=160 is a per-process hard stop on the Astra worker's running total (see _note_cost for where it stops the run; pair it with an OpenAI project budget). context_window=full resends every prior decision frame each query (history capped by max_history_tokens), so per-episode input grows quadratically with steps: estimate cost before launch.
_note_cost: Projection for the 15 mazes with caching on, per model: the 2D projection (run_config.mechanics_15_2d.json's _note_cost, same formula, maze lengths and prices) plus the start map. count_tokens on M10 gives 477 tokens per history step (576x576 first-person frame plus inventory and action), as in 2D, and 481 once for the top-down start map, which is read from cache on every later query. Output per query: Opus 5.5 xhigh averaged ~790 on the 3D rerun of r1_S4_10x10_dense_1 (2D: ~450); Kimi K3 and GPT-6 Astra were not run in 3D, so their 2D figures are used (~10.5k, ~220). Total (input + output) over the 15 mazes if every episode runs 1x / 1.5x / 2x / 3x (the step cap) its shortest path: Opus 5.5 ~$25 / ~$44 / ~$67 / ~$125; Kimi K3 ~$261 / ~$400 / ~$546 / ~$856; Astra ~$34 / ~$63 / ~$102 / ~$204; panel ~$319 / ~$507 / ~$714 / ~$1,185. Kimi K3's output dominates, as in 2D. Astra's spend_cap_usd=160 stops its worker if episodes average about 2.6x their shortest path, as in 2D. Calibrate on M10 (run_config.mechanics_15_3d_calib.json) and re-project from its measured episode lengths and output tokens before launch.
_note_launch: Launch with difficulty_max_static_score = 8000 (--difficulty-max-static-score 8000, fleet DIFFICULTY_MAX=8000), set for this panel: the largest static score is M10's, about 7,840. Stage 2 refuses the run if any selected maze scores above the cap. Stage 2 takes tens of minutes per maze on these 18x18 mechanics mazes: pre-score with a local coordinator-prepare and launch with PRESCORED_TASKS. Serve the coordinator with STALE_AFTER_SECONDS >= 12600 for the lockstep Opus group. The render block names mujoco3d, so launch_distributed.sh runs deploy/setup_mujoco3d.sh (OSMesa plus the mujoco3d extra) on every VM; a local run needs MUJOCO_GL=osmesa or egl.
_note_cache: Prompt caching on, as in 2D: the start map and every earlier frame, inventory and action sit in the cached prefix; the current frame, budget/stall lines and question come after the last breakpoint. Measured 2026-10-21 on r1_S4_10x10_dense_1 in 3D (first_person + start_map, 31 queries, solved): Opus 5.5 sync read 86% of its input from cache (93% by the last query), each query reading exactly what the previous one wrote; Kimi K3's two-query check read the 5,206-token prefix. Opus: Message Batches with batch_cache_ttl=1h on the fleet. GPT-6 Astra: enable_prompt_cache=true (explicit breakpoints). Kimi K3: prompt_cache_ttl=1h. See run_config.mechanics_15_2d.json's _note_cache.
